result:
I added role filtering, name/email search and an Export CSV button to the users list. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it has been checked.

- **Filters:** `features/users/components/users-list.tsx` now has a search box and a role dropdown (All roles, Admin, User) above the table. Both filter the already loaded list in the browser. Search matches the full name or the email, ignoring case. The page is already restricted to admins, so the filters are too.
- **Export CSV:** The button downloads `users.csv` with the columns Name, Email, Role and Joined. It exports only the users that pass the current filters, and it is disabled when none do. The Joined column uses `formatDate`.
- **CSV code:** It's in the new `features/users/utils/export-users-csv.ts`. Every value is quoted. Values starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading apostrophe so spreadsheet apps don't run them as formulas.
- **Controls:** The search box and dropdown use the shared `Input` and `Select` from `@/components/ui/form`. Neither takes an `onChange` directly, so I pass it through their `registration` prop. That works with their current types, but it is an unusual use of that prop.
